# Lakeport Grand Resort & Casino — Security Operations Plan (excerpt)

## Property

The resort has the North Tower and the South Tower (1,100 guest rooms) above a 90,000 sq ft casino floor. Table games are in Pits 1–6; slots are in Slot Banks 10–48 around the center bar. Guests park in Garage A and Garage B; employees park in Lot 4.

## Entrances and the retail promenade

Public access is through Entrances 1–5. Entrance 3 opens onto the retail promenade, where Store #1142 (the resort gift shop) and Tenant Space 214 are on Level 2.

## Notifications

A cybersecurity incident that activates the incident response plan is reported to the Gaming Control Board. Suspicious cash activity goes to FinCEN through the Compliance Officer. The Director of Security calls the Lakeport Police Department and the fire marshal for life-safety events. Room 1412 is the security command post during tower evacuations.
